content:
Priya Shah: Heads-up — automated anomaly flagged for Nebula (hosted API). Spend vs commit jumped ~3.2x overnight. seeing alerts on quota and billing dashboard :warning:
Liam Ortega: ugh. Is this sustained traffic or a runaway test? any specific endpoints spiking?
Eva Chen: checking logs now. initial sample shows lots of generate calls to /v1/chat with long contexts. Might be a prompt loop.
billing-bot: [Alert] customer:Nebula | hosted_spend_delta = +218% (24h) | commit_remaining = 42% | alert_level = high | link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/nebulacorp
Priya Shah: Liam — can you confirm if Nebula enabled any new CI jobs or feature flags yesterday? Marco — any account-side notes from renewal or onboarding?
Marco (PSM): No new commits from them. Onboarding complete last month. Had a short enablement call Friday; they mentioned experimenting with multi-turn assistants.
Liam Ortega: I queried our telemetry:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as toks, count(*) as calls
FROM hosted_requests
WHERE customer_id='nebula' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY toks DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Liam Ortega: Top route is `/v1/chat/generate` — average tokens per call jumped from ~120 to ~980.
Eva Chen: That matches a prompt-loop hypothesis. Also seeing elevated 429s for a short burst at 03:12 UTC. Possibly retry storm.
Priya Shah: Actions: 1) Liam — reach out to Nebula to ask about test runs and ask them to throttle. 2) Eva — mute auto-scaling alerts for noise, but keep billing guard; add temporary rate-limit override if they request help. 3) Marco — flag renewal risk if they don't respond in 24h.
Liam Ortega: I'll ping their eng lead now (cc @nebula-eng) and ask for request IDs. Drafting msg: "Hey — we flagged a big spend bump from your account; can you confirm if this was an intentional test? We're happy to help throttle or add temporary limits."
Marco (PSM): Also propose a quick enablement session on batching and prompt length best practices — might prevent recurrence.
Eva Chen: From infra side, I set a temporary per-route cap for Nebula at 1.5x baseline. If they need more, we'll coordinate. Logged the change: `policy:nebula-temp-cap-2076543210`
billing-bot: [Note] guard_policy_applied customer:Nebula | policy=nebula-temp-cap-2076543210 | effected_at=2076543600
Priya Shah: Thank you. I'll follow up with a one-pager on cost-control tips for hosted customers (batching, caching, context windows). Marco — can you attach it to the renewal thread?
Marco (PSM): Yep — will add and tag sales if they escalate.
Liam Ortega: Pinged them. Reply expected within 2 hours. I'll update this thread when they respond. :arrow_right:
Priya Shah: Great. If they confirm it's a bug/loop, we can offer a one-time credit depending on impact. For now keep the guard and watch flags.
Liam Ortega: Update: Nebula responded — "thanks, that was an internal load-test gone awry. we've paused it and rolling back." They requested temporary higher cap for tonight's run.
Eva Chen: Approved temporary bump for tonight (limit request id: bump-2076543720) with strict alerting. Will revert automatically at 06:00 UTC.
Priya Shah: Marking resolved for now. Next steps: send cost-control doc, schedule 30m enablement, and note potential renewal risk mitigated. Closing action items in 48h unless new flags appear. :white_check_mark:
